notes.title: 📢 Lustful Apocalypse – Development Update
notes.notes:
[p]Hey everyone,[/p][p]We want to sincerely thank you for your support, feedback, and excitement around [b]Lustful Apocalypse[/b]. It's been amazing to see the community engage with our vision.[/p][p]That said, we've made the difficult decision to [b]put the project on hold[/b]. Due to limited resources and other ongoing commitments, we’re unable to continue development at this time.[/p][p]It may be a [b]long while before we return to Lustful Apocalypse[/b] — if at all. We still believe in the project and hope to come back to it when the time is right, but for now, it's on the shelf.[/p][p]In the meantime, you can enjoy our other completed games at [url="https://demonalterstudios.co.uk/"]demonalterstudios.co.uk[/url] — your support there helps keep our studio going and fuels future creations.[/p][p]Thank you again for being part of this journey. We appreciate you.[/p][p]With love,
[b]The Demon Alter Studios Team[/b][/p]

notes.title: Lustful Apocalypse - Update 0.8.0.5 is Live! 🚨
notes.notes:
Hey Survivors,

We’ve been hard at work shaping the next phase of Lustful Apocalypse, and v0.8.0.5 marks a major step forward as we begin building out the massive open world you've all been waiting for.

Here’s what’s new in this update:

🌍 Massive Open World Begins
We’ve officially started constructing the large-scale world map. The old Forest Level has been removed, and new zones will roll out progressively.

🌱 Visual Upgrades

    Brand-new PBR Grass & Dirt Textures for a much more realistic, immersive world.

    Reimported foliage props into our improved pipeline to match the new environment standards.

🛠️ Performance & Framework

    Switched the project to MONO Framework for smoother performance and better cross-platform support.

    Cleaned house: all unused assets have been removed to optimise the build.

🧬 Character & Animation Updates

    Wyn’s animation data and morphs have been updated for improved expression and motion.

    Her new outfit is now fully synced with her animations for seamless transitions.

🔓 New Progression Unlocks

    Sewer & Subway zones unlock at Level 3

    Breeding system unlocks at Level 5

    Boss encounters unlock at Level 10

As always, your support makes this world possible. Thank you for helping us grow Lustful Apocalypse into something wild, immersive, and totally unique.

More juicy updates coming soon 💀❤️

notes.title: 🎉 Lustful Apocalypse – Version 0.8.0.4 is LIVE!
notes.notes:
Hey survivors!
We’ve just launched a massive new update, and it’s more than just an upgrade — this is a brand-new base build for Lustful Apocalypse. That means better performance, improved stability, and the groundwork laid for a flood of future content. 💦

Here’s everything we’ve done in this spicy overhaul:
🧭 Quest & Dialog Overhaul

    All quests have been completely reworked to feel smoother, smarter, and more connected.

    NPC dialog rewritten and improved – expect more personality, better flow, and deeper interactions.

    Temporarily disabled all quests while we prep them for final testing.

    Tutorial has also been temporarily removed while we rebuild it from scratch.

🌍 Map & Level Changes

    Starter Map is now a safe zone – explore without fear (for now).

    Enemy NPCs relocated to their own maps to improve pacing and balance.

    Sewer Level added! – With new props, fresh NPCs, and lots of dirty atmosphere.

    Subway completely rebuilt with better textures, lighting, and layout.

    Breeding Room revamped – hotter, smoother, and easier to navigate.

    Main Wasteland Map rebuilt with new paths and brand-new props.

    Improved lighting and camera depth-of-field throughout the game.

💬 Characters & Technical Fixes

    New Male NPC added (no interactions yet – he’s just brooding for now).

    Dialogic name fixes – no more weird labels or missing names.

    Wyn’s spawn fixed – she now appears where she’s supposed to.

    Ogre Chief now roams the Subway, and Wolf Chief guards the Sewer – good luck.

🖥️ Interface & Core Updates

    Removed HP Orbs & Controls from GUI – cleaner look, better feel.

    This update is now the new core build – expect more consistent updates from here on out.

    Lots of behind-the-scenes fixes and system improvements for stability.

🔞 New Sexy Content

    Sex scenes now include dialog!
    That’s right – it’s not just the visuals anymore. Your character (and your partners) now have something to say in the moment…

Thank you for all your amazing support – seriously, none of this happens without you. ❤️
This update clears the path for some seriously exciting content we’ll be rolling out next, including quest reactivation, interactive NPCs, and more wild new levels.

More to come soon – stay hot, stay safe, and don’t trust anything that lives in the sewer. 😉

notes.title: Lustful Apocalypse Update 0.8.0.2 — “Rebuild and Rampage”
notes.notes:
We’ve been working hard behind the scenes to bring you a smoother, sexier, and downright more monstrous experience. Here’s what’s new and improved in 0.8.0.2:

🛠️ Bug Squashing & Plugin Fixes

    Kicked that pesky Subdiv plugin to the curb. No more glitches messing with your chaos!

👹 NPC Overhaul Madness

    Our enemies leveled up: all Enemy NPC code is rebuilt with the shiny new pipeline — smarter, faster, deadlier.

    Bug NPCs and Hugger NPCs got the full Blender makeover — models and animations are fresher than ever.

    The mighty Ogre returns with rebuilt models and animations, looking meaner and moving smoother.

    Wolf NPCs are still rocking their classic FBX style for now — vintage vibes!

⚙️ Performance & Optimization

    We optimized assets across all scenes with Level of Detail (LOD) — expect better performance without sacrificing the carnage.

    Navigation agents recalculated so enemies chase you better... if you’re quick enough!

    Scene loading speed? Blazing fast now. No more awkward waiting between your apocalyptic escapades.

🎭 Animations & Outfits

    All sex animation data rebuilt for all scenes — smoother moves guaranteed.

    Outfits got a full rebuild too, using the new pipeline. Looking good while destroying the world!

🏚️ Map & Gameplay Fixes

    Removed all buildings causing movement issues — no more getting stuck while running wild.

    Joining faction scenes for Wolf & Ogre have been updated — choose your pack wisely!

    Temporarily removed teleport ability (it was bugged, but we’ll bring it back better than ever).

Get ready to dive back into Lustful Apocalypse with style, speed, and savage new threats. Keep your weapons sharp and your wits sharper!

notes.title: Lustful Apocalypse v0.7.9.5 – “Rise & Grind” Update!

It’s time to flex those stats and level up, survivor. The apocalypse just got grindier (and sexier). Here's what’s new in this smouldering slice of chaos:

🧠 Implemented Full Levelling System
Your journey now has a proper sense of progression! Level up, boost your power, and become the wasteland's most dangerous (and desirable) badass.

💀 Enemy NPCs Now Grant Experience
Murder with meaning! Every enemy you take down now feeds your XP bar. Fight smarter, grow stronger.

🌀 Portals Now Require Level, Not Power
Forget raw power – now you’ll need the right level to pass through those glowing rifts. No more cheese, it’s time to earn your way in.

🕯️ Removed Torches & Extra Lighting
We’ve stripped away the extra lights for a darker, moodier apocalypse. Embrace the shadows – and maybe bump into something hot.

notes.title: Lustful Apocalypse 0.7.5 - Major Update
notes.notes:
We’re thrilled to share the latest update for Lustful Apocalypse, packed with reworked systems, exciting new quests, and immersive gameplay enhancements. Here’s what you can expect in version 0.7.5:

🗺️ Explore Mode Overhaul

[list]
[*]     Reworked Functionality: Enemies and Huggers in Explore have been fine-tuned for improved dynamics and challenge.
[*]     Expanded World: The Explore environment is now richer, with double the enemies and props to encounter.
[*]     Navigation Agents: Enemies now utilise advanced navigation agents, enhancing their realism and responsiveness.
[*]     Clothing Mechanics: Wyn’s clothing can now be knocked off and picked up during gameplay, introducing a 'Find Some Clothes' quest for added depth. Clothing conditions also persist across scenes.
[*]     Visual Enhancements: Fixed scaling issues with the captured animation and resolved phasing issues for a smoother experience.
[/list]

🔥 New Quests and Characters

    Quests Added:

        Summon Horus

        The Dark Domain

        Updates to Burny’s 'Horus Crystals' quest.

    Dynamic Quest NPC: More interactive and immersive than ever.

    New Characters:

        Bella – Explore her role and dialogue in the story.

        Horus – A key character with deep lore connections.

👑 Epic Boss Encounter

    Introducing King Grey, a formidable new boss accessible through the mysterious portal. Prepare your army for an epic battle!

💡 Gameplay & GUI Fixes

    Resolved War & Boss Mode teleport issues that previously caused crashes. Teleports now lock the mouse position for smoother transitions.

    Fixed several GUI glitches for a cleaner interface.

🎁 Additional Features

    Added three new collectables to discover in Explore.

    Collections Screen revamped for better usability.

    Cleaned up by removing unnecessary files.

❗ Important Notice: New Game Required

This is a major game update, and due to significant changes in core functionality, players will need to start a new game for their saves to work correctly. We apologise for the inconvenience but guarantee that these enhancements will make your experience even more enjoyable!

This update also includes a core code rework for enemies in Explore, improving functionality and fixing issues like random health decreases in War Mode.

Your support continues to fuel Lustful Apocalypse. We’re committed to delivering a polished, captivating experience, and updates like this are only possible thanks to you. Let us know what you think of the new features, and keep an eye out for what’s coming next!
